versions.changelog:
- Clarified that the skill transfers tokens from the OpenAnt wallet, and updated the description to emphasize the OpenAnt context.
- Added "OpenAnt wallet send" to the list of use cases and natural language mapping.
- Updated error handling: changed "No Turnkey credentials found" to "No credentials found" for alignment with platform terminology.
- Minor clarifications in descriptions to reduce ambiguity and emphasize OpenAnt-specific behavior.

- Updated references from "EVM" to "Base" for clarity in chain and token support.
- Clarified support: only Solana and Base chains are now listed (EVM references removed).
- Updated argument descriptions and table entries to match new terminology (e.g., "Base" instead of "EVM").
- Adjusted error messages and NEVER section for chain/address compatibility to align with new scope.
- Minor consistency and phrasing improvements throughout the documentation.

Version 0.1.1 of send-token

- No functional or documentation changes detected in this release.
- All commands, usage guidelines, and examples remain unchanged.
- No new features, bug fixes, or enhancements included.

- Initial release of the send-token skill.
- Supports sending tokens on Solana or Base (EVM) using the OpenAnt CLI.
- Allows sending native coins (SOL, ETH), named tokens (USDC), and arbitrary tokens by mint/contract address.
- Ensures user confirmation and address validation before transfers; provides safety checks for irreversible blockchain transactions.
- Includes detailed instructions, command examples, and error handling guidance.
